name: Syed Bilal Ahmad
hero_lead: MCA graduate from Aligarh Muslim University building **agentic AI**, **machine learning** systems and **intelligent mobile apps**. I care about RLHF, ethical AI and technology that solves real problems.
about: I'm an AI/ML engineer and a Master of Computer Applications graduate from **Aligarh Muslim University**, with an undergraduate foundation in **Mathematics**. I build at the intersection of machine learning, generative AI and software — from training models in PyTorch and TensorFlow to designing autonomous agents with Salesforce Agentforce and shipping Android apps in Kotlin.

Most recently I interned as a **Salesforce & AI Developer at Infoglen**, integrating Agentforce and Einstein capabilities into enterprise workflows. Before that, I led the AI/ML track at the Computer Science Society, mentoring peers through data preprocessing, model development and evaluation, and teaching school students prompt engineering and real-world AI.

Linux is my home environment for scripting and automation, and MATLAB has sharpened my numerical analysis. I'm currently exploring **RLHF**, **ethical AI** and **agentic systems** — and I'm looking for a team where I can turn that curiosity into impact.
